meta.title: Imenɣan ipunikiyen (264–146 send Ɛisa)
meta.desc: Krad n yimenɣan ger Qarṭaǧ d Ṛuma : Mylae, Ecnomus, Égades, amennuɣ n Iɛeskriyen Uqeṛḍasen, Hanibal, Cannes, Zama, aḥeṛṣ n 149–146, lemɛahda d ttalan.
hero.title: Imenɣan ipunikiyen
hero.lede: Krad n yimenɣan deg meyya d tmanya ɛecra n iseggasen : amennuɣ ger Qarṭaǧ d Ṛuma ɣef Lebḥer Ageraɣlan. Awal yekka-d seg latinit punicus, « afiniqi » — d isem i gefkan Iṛumaniyen i Yiqarṭaǧiyen.

before.title: Uqbel Ṛuma : Igrikiyen n Sicile
before.aside: Ugar n sin iqrunen, aɛdaw n Qarṭaǧ mačči d Ṛuma maca d timdinin tigrikiyin, s telqey di Sicile. Akked Ṛuma, imsagaren qqimen aṭas lweqt ttwaseflen s lemɛahda.
before.sicT: Sin iqrunen n umenɣi ɣef Sicile
before.sicily.0.v: Dduklen akked Yitruskiyen, Iqarṭaǧiyen nnuɣen ɣef lebḥer n Corse akked Igrikiyen n Phocée. Nɣelben s telɣa, maca Iphocéens xesren tugget n lbabura-nsen ǧǧan tigzirt (Hérodote, I, 166).
before.sicily.1.v: Gélon n Syracuse, yeddukel akked Théron n Agrigente, yebɣa ad yesdukkel Sicile tagrikit. Lɛesker n Hamilkar Umagoni yettwaḥlek ; Qarṭaǧ tesɛa ahat lɛawna n Pers, i yettazzlen Tagrikt deg useggas-nni s yiman-is.
before.sicily.2.v: Hanibal, mmi-s n mmi-s n Hamilkar, yehdem Sélinonte akked Himère (409). Yemmut s ṭṭaɛun zdat Agrigente ; win i t-id-yeqbalen Himilcon yeṭṭef tamdint, imbeɛd yegr akked Denys n Syracuse talwit d asteɛfu kan.
before.sicily.3.v: Denys yeṭṭef Motyé, lqelɛa tapunit tameqqrant n ugmur n tegzirt, i d-teqbal mbeɛd Qarṭaǧ. Aḥeṛṣ aqarṭaǧi n Syracuse yettwakkes deg 396 ɣef ddemma n ṭṭaɛun.
before.sicily.4.v: Mbeɛd sețța iseggasen n yimenɣan yettḍerrin akked uɣelli n Crimisos zdat Timoléon, Qarṭaǧ teqqim kan deg ugmur d unzul-agmur n tegzirt.
before.sicily.5.v: Ameɣbun n Syracuse yeṭṭef Messine imbeɛd yettḥuddu lxiwanat ipuniyen. Yettwaḥeṛṣ deg Syracuse, yettawi amenɣi ɣer Tafrikt (wali ddaw-agi).
before.sicily.6.v: Yettusawel sɣur Igrikiyen n Sicile, agellid n Épire yeṭṭef qrib akk lqwaɛed ipuniyen maca yerreẓ zdat Lilybée, imbeɛd yeffeɣ tigzirt.
before.treaties.0.v: Yettwaḥrez sɣur Polybe (III, 22), i t-yesersen di zzman n ikunsulen imezwura. Iṛumaniyen ur zemren ara ad aɛḏun « Ucenfiṛ Ihlan » ; Qarṭaǧ tegall ur tḍurru ara timdinin tilatiniyin.
before.treaties.1.v: Akken i d-yeqqar Polybe (III, 24), yettwasers sɣur Diodore d Tite-Live. Amḍiq ittwagdlen ɣef Iṛumaniyen yesmɣuṛ armi d Hispanya (Mastia) ; Sardaigne akked Libya sekkṛent-asen.
before.treaties.2.v: Akken i d-yeqqar umesnezruy Philinos n Agrigente, Ṛuma teǧǧa Sicile, Qarṭaǧ teǧǧa Italya. Polybe (III, 26) yenkar belli yella ; Tite-Live yettwabder tuɣalin deg 306. Tamsalt teqqim d asmeyya.
before.treaties.3.v: Timdinin-agi gallant ad ɛawant yiwet tayeḍ mgal ugellid n Épire (Polybe, III, 25). D amtawa-nsent aneggaru send umenɣi.
before.trNote: Lemɛahda-agi ttaken i Qarṭaǧ amagnu n ttjara di Tafrikt n ugafa akked i Ṛuma laman n Latium. Lemsawat-nsen yettnernin aṭas yettwali aṭas n tikwal d asekken n tjeɣrit tettnerni.
before.invaders.0.paras.0: Deg 310, Hamilkar, mmi-s n Giscon, yeṭṭef qrib akk Sicile yeḥreṣ Syracuse. Agathocle yerẓ aḥeṛṣ, yers ɣer Ras Addar yesserɣ lbabura-ines iwakken ad yekkes seg yirgazen-is yal usirem n tuɣalin (Diodore, XX).
before.invaders.0.paras.1: I tikkelt tamezwarut, lɛesker n uɛdaw yeḥdem amur n Tafrikt n Qarṭaǧ, i deg kra n yiḍfan ilibikiyen ffɣen. Qarṭaǧ teṭṭuḥettem ad d-tessawel lɛesker-is seg Sicile. Amenɣi yekka krad iseggasen yefra s urewl n Agathocle, i yeǧǧan lɛesker-is (307).
before.invaders.1.paras.0: Mbeɛd tinyafiyin-is iɣezzif ɣef Ṛuma di Italya, agellid n Épire yeɛdu ɣer Sicile s ssawal n Yigrikiyen. Yeṭṭef Éryx akked qrib akk ugmur apunik, maca yerreẓ zdat Lilybée, i lbabura-ines ur zemrent ara ad sekkṛent.
before.invaders.1.paras.1: Yeffeɣ deg 276, yeqqar-d, akken i d-yeqqar Plutarque, yeǧǧa Sicile d amḍiq n umenɣi i Iṛumaniyen akked Yiqarṭaǧiyen. Tnac iseggasen mbeɛd, yeldi umenɣi apunik amezwaru.
three.title: Krad n yimenɣan
three.aside: Amenɣi ɣef Sicile, amenɣi ɣef Lebḥer Ageraɣlan, amenɣi iwakken ad tettwahdem Qarṭaǧ.

first.alt: Tagejdit n lbabur apuni n Marsala
first.caption: Lbabur apuni n Marsala, lqern wis 3 send Ɛisa
first.paras.0: Deg 264, Imamertiniyen, iɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen ṭṭfen Messine, ssawalen Ṛuma mgal Syracuse akked Qarṭaǧ. Ṛuma tezger ucenfiṛ : d tikkelt tamezwarut i llejyunat-is ffɣent Italya. Qarṭaǧ teṭṭef dinna ugmur n Sicile akked lebḥer.
first.paras.1: Tezmert n wakal, Ṛuma teg lebḥer-is s usegzi n lbabur apuni yettwasersen ɣef tgaraf, tesnulfa corvus, tsidast n tɛerḍa i yesbeddlen amenɣi n lebḥer ɣer wemnuɣ n yiɛeskriyen n uḍar. Mbeɛd 23 iseggasen n umenɣi ɣef wakal d lebḥer, Qarṭaǧ tettwanɣelb di Tegzirin n Égades teṭṭuḥettem ad teffeɣ Sicile.
first.stats.1.t: n lbabura n umenɣi i yexsar Ṛuma (Polybe) ; azal n 500 i yexsar Qarṭaǧ
first.stats.2.t: n ttalan i yettwaḥettem Qarṭaǧ ad texles deg talwit
first.battles.0.t: Ṛuma tezger ɣer Sicile iwakken ad teɛawen Imamertiniyen : tazwart n umenɣi.
first.battles.1.t: Mbeɛd uḥeṛṣ iɣezzif, Ṛuma teṭṭef lqelɛa tapunit tameqqrant n unzul n tegzirt.
first.battles.2.t: Tanyafit taṛumanit tamezwarut n lebḥer, s ddemma n corvus ; akunsul Duilius yeṭṭef triyunf.
first.battles.3.t: Yiwet seg tmenɣiwin timeqqranin n lebḥer deg ddunit taqdimt : azal n 330 n lbabura iṛumaniyen mgal 350 ipuniyen. Ṛuma tenjer di Tafrikt.
first.battles.4.t: Aspartiyat Xanthippe, i Qarṭaǧ, yeḥlek lɛesker n Régulus s ilfan akked ineggafen ; Régulus yettwaṭṭef.
first.battles.5.t: Adherbal yehdem lebḥer n ukunsul Claudius Pulcher — i yegren, akken qqaren, ifer iqeddsen ɣer lebḥer mi ugin ad ččen.
first.battles.6.t: Hamilkar Barka yezgi di Sicile amenɣi uffir i Ṛuma ur tezmir ara ad t-tessemẓi.
first.battles.7.t: Ass n 10 meɣres, lbabura n Lutatius Catulus ɛerḍen lbabura ipuniyen ɛemmṛen s lqut : azal n 50 ttwaghuzen, 70 ttwaṭṭfen. Tagara n umenɣi.
merc.title: Amennuɣ n Iɛeskriyen Uqeṛḍasen
merc.paras.0: Yehdem s umenɣi, Qarṭaǧ ur tezmir ara ad texles azal n 20 000 n yiɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen i d-yuɣalen seg Sicile. Kkren-d ddaw n Spendios, Mathos d Autarite ; timdinin tilibikiyin, ḥeṛṣent s lxerj, dduklent-d yid-sen, imbeɛd Utique akked Hippo. Qarṭaǧ s yiman-is tettwaḥeṛṣ.
merc.paras.1: Hamilkar Barka yesserɣel-iten deg lkamin n « Scie » (238), imbeɛd yeḥlek Mathos. Polybe yessawel-as amenɣi « ur yettwasemmeḥ ara ». Flaubert yegg-it d amḍiq n Salammbô (1862).
merc.boxD: Deg 238–237, Ṛuma teṭṭef Sardaigne, imbeɛd Corse, tḥuddu s umenɣi Qarṭaǧ yeεyan : tessuter 1200 n ttalan-nniḍen. I Polybe, lmeεna-agi tella d yiwet seg ssababat n umenɣi wis sin.
second.aside: Ameqqran akteṛ seg krad n yimenɣan. Sețța iɛecrin iseggasen, Hanibal yennuɣ di Italya war ma yexsar ula d yiwen n umenɣi usrid.
second.paras.0: Mbeɛd lexsas n Sicile, At Barka bennun di Hispanya tazmert tamaynut, tarikt s lmɛadin n nnuqra-ines. Deg 219, Hanibal yeṭṭef Sagonte ; Ṛuma tesres amenɣi. Yezger Idurar n Pyrénées akked Idurar n Alpes, yawi amenɣi ɣer Italya.
second.paras.1: Ṛuma tegri amenɣi usrid (tirrategin n Fabius « Win Yettwaxeṛṭalen ») tḥuddu deg wemkan-nniḍen : di Hispanya, imbeɛd di Tafrikt. Scipion yers deg 204 ; Hanibal, yettusawel, yettwanɣelb di Zama deg 202. Qarṭaǧ teqqim tedder, maca war leslaḥ.
second.battles.0.t: Ṭsam wagguren n uḥeṛṣ ; aɣelli n temdint yesnulfa amenɣi.
second.battles.1.t: Hanibal yezger Idurar n Alpes akked ilfan-is, yekcem Italya.
second.battles.2.t: Tinyafiyin tiamezwura di ugafa n Italya ; Igaliyen dduklen.
second.battles.3.t: Tuffra deg usigna : 15 000 n Iṛumaniyen ttwanɣan, akunsul Flaminius netta daɣen.
second.battles.4.t: Azzel s snat n tama-s : aɣelli iẓayen akteṛ deg umezruy n Ṛuma.
second.battles.5.t: Ṛuma teṭṭef tamdint mbeɛd sin iseggasen n uḥeṛṣ ; Archimède yettwanɣa dinna.
second.battles.6.t: Scipion yeṭṭef s lεjeb taneddawt n At Barka di Hispanya.
second.battles.7.t: Hasdrubal Barka, i d-yusan ad yesnefses gma-s, yettwanɣa.
second.battles.8.t: Aɣelli aqarṭaǧi yettwaḥettmen : Hispanya tettwaxesra, Gadir tefka iman-is.
second.battles.9.t: Hanibal yettwanɣelb di Tafrikt sɣur Scipion akked Masinisa.
second.imgs.0.d: Tamdint tiberiyen tamddakelt n Ṛuma ɣer unzul n Èbre : aḥeṛṣ-ines sɣur Hanibal yella d casus belli.
second.imgs.1.d: Ɣef rrif agafa n ilel, lɛesker aṛumani yettwaṭṭef deg tikli n webrid : tuffra tameqqrant akteṛ n zzman aqdim.

map.aside: Timura n Qarṭaǧ d Ṛuma seg 814 armi d 146, imbeɛd tikli n Hanibal, s umussu.

treaty.caption: Amenɣi n Zama (202 send Ɛisa)
treaty.title: Amtawa n talwit
treaty.rows.0.v: n ttalan n nnuqra, ad ttwaxelsen deg 50 n iseggasen n 200 n ttalan
treaty.rows.1.v: n trirèmes kan : wayen-nniḍen n lebḥer n umenɣi yettunefk yettwasserɣ
treaty.rows.2.v: akk ttunefken, akked legdel n usles n wiyaḍ imaynuten
treaty.rows.3.v: yegdel ɣer berra n Tafrikt, akked di Tafrikt war laṣel n Ṛuma
treaty.rows.4.v: Qarṭaǧ teṭṭuḥettem ad as-terr timura n yimezwura-s
treaty.note: Qarṭaǧ tettali s lɣaci : deg 191, tessumer ad texles yakk deg yiwet tikkelt ayen i d-yeqqimen n lexlaṣ. Ṛuma tagi — lexlaṣ n yal aseggas yella daɣen d azday n lḥuḍuɛ.
third.intro: Xemsin iseggasen mbeɛd Zama, Qarṭaǧ tfukk lexlaṣ-ines tettali s ssɛaya. Di Ṛuma, Caton Amɣar yesmed yal taɣect-is s « Carthago delenda est » : ilaq ad tettwahdem Qarṭaǧ.
third.rows.0.v: Tḥeṛṣ sɣur Masinisa, Qarṭaǧ tezzi aɛesskar iwakken ad teḥdar iman-is, mgal ṛṛay n Ṛuma : d laṣel i gebɣan.
third.rows.1.v: Lɛesker n ukunsul yers ɣer Utique. Qarṭaǧ tefka 300 n warraw n twaculin timeqqranin d imeḥbas, imbeɛd, akken i d-yeqqar Appien, 200 000 n leslaḥ akked 2000 n yisebbaren.
third.rows.2.v: Ṛuma tessuter imzedɣen ad ǧǧen tamdint ad zedɣen ɣer 80 n stades (azal n 15 km) seg lebḥer. Qarṭaǧ tugi.
third.rows.3.v: Tamdint tuɣal tezzi leslaḥ : xeddmen iḍ akked wass, tilawin, akken i d-yeqqar Appien, gezzment ac̣wawen-nsent i tsiɣdin n yisebbaren. Lhuǧum iṛumaniyen rrẓen.
third.rows.4.v: Scipion Émilien yeṭṭef lqiyada yesekkeṛ lebḥer s lseqqa.
third.rows.5.v: Sețța wussan n umenɣi deg iberdan armi d Byrsa. Azal n 50 000 n wid i d-yeqqimen fkan iman-nsen ttwazenzen d aklan. Tameṭṭut n unezwi Hasdrubal tegr iman-is deg times akked warraw-is.
third.alt: Lxrab n lḥamamat n Antonin di Qarṭaǧ
third.caption: Lḥamamat n Antonin — Qarṭaǧ taṛumanit, yettwasers daɣen deg umḍiq-nni
third.mythD: Tamdint tettwasserɣ akal-is yettwanɛal, maca ula d yiwen uɣbalu aqdim ur yebder ara lmelḥ : d asnulfu atrar. Tutlayt d tgemmi tapunit qqimen ddren, Ṛuma tesres daɣen Qarṭaǧ lqern mbeɛd, ddaw n César d Auguste ; tuɣal d taneddawt n Tafrikt taṛumanit.

more.items.1.d: Acuɣer Qarṭaǧ, war leslaḥ maca tesεa ssɛaya, tezga tḥuddu Ssenaṭ.
more.items.2.d: Timura, tikli n Hanibal, tirzan akked yimdukkal.
